distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records the taxon from Xizang under the source name Pityogenes coniferae. Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the historical Taiwan record as doubtful and likely based on Shiraki material. Taiwan is retained as Questionable and is not added to the current distribution summary.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) reports Pinus griffithii (乔松). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Pityogenes scitus Blandford, 1893.

taxonomic_history.name: Pityophthorus coniferae
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 30.

taxonomic_history.name: Pityogenes scitus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Pityogenes scitus Blandford, 1893, VSN_4223. 黄复生等 (2015) uses Pityogenes coniferae; the historical source name is retained without changing stable VSN identity.
